title: Young and Beautiful
goal: Learn the words first, notice will, when and the present perfect, and think about what the song really asks.
goal_it: Impara prima le parole, nota will, when e il present perfect e pensa a cosa chiede davvero la canzone.

steps.title: About the song
en: Title: Young and Beautiful. Artist: Lana Del Rey, an American singer-songwriter. The song was written for the soundtrack of the film The Great Gatsby (2013), a story about money, parties and lost love.
Search for the title and the artist in your own music app. Listen three times this week, each time with a different job:
Listening 1: catch the words from the next screen. Listening 2: notice the three grammar points. Listening 3: think about what the singer really wants to know.
it: Titolo: Young and Beautiful. Artista: Lana Del Rey, cantautrice americana. La canzone è stata scritta per la colonna sonora del film Il grande Gatsby (2013), una storia di soldi, feste e amore perduto.
Cerca titolo e artista nella tua app di musica. Ascoltala tre volte questa settimana, ogni volta con un compito diverso:
Ascolto 1: individua le parole della prossima schermata. Ascolto 2: nota i tre punti di grammatica. Ascolto 3: pensa a cosa vuole davvero sapere chi canta.

steps.title: Words you will hear
en: These words are in the song or very close to its world. Learn them first, then try to catch them while you listen.
it: Queste parole sono nella canzone o molto vicine al suo mondo. Imparale prima, poi prova a riconoscerle mentre ascolti.

head: English
Italiano
Example
rows: My legs are aching after the run.
I will remember this day forever.
We had a wild night in Rome.
Her ring has a small diamond.
I ate nothing but bread today.

steps.q: My back is aching after the gym. 'Aching' is closest to...
steps.q_it: Mi fa male la schiena dopo la palestra. 'Aching' è più vicino a...
options: shining
hurting
resting
growing
steps.why: Aching = hurting a little, for a long time.
steps.why_it: Aching = che fa male, in modo continuo.

options: I had nothing but a coffee for breakfast.
Nothing but I had a coffee.
I had nothing but not a coffee.
I had nothing but of a coffee.
steps.why: Nothing but = only. After it we put the thing directly: nothing but a coffee.
steps.why_it: Nothing but = solo. Dopo si mette direttamente la cosa: nothing but a coffee.

steps.q: I have ___ but my phone in my bag. (solo il telefono)
steps.q_it: Ho solo il telefono nella borsa.
steps.hint: the first word of the expression
steps.why: Nothing but + noun = only that noun.
steps.why_it: Nothing but + nome = solo quel nome.

steps.title: Three grammar points to watch for
steps.title_it: Tre punti di grammatica da tenere d'occhio
en: 1. Will for questions about the future: Will you still...? A question with will asks about something that is not certain yet.
2. When + present simple, even for the future. After when we do not use will: Call me when you arrive (not when you will arrive).
3. Present perfect for life experience: I have seen, I have done. We talk about experiences in our life, without saying exactly when.
During listening 2, try to notice where the singer uses each one.
it: 1. Will per le domande sul futuro: Will you still...? Una domanda con will riguarda qualcosa non ancora certo.
2. When + present simple, anche per il futuro. Dopo when non si usa will: Call me when you arrive (non when you will arrive).
3. Present perfect per le esperienze di vita: I have seen, I have done. Parliamo di esperienze nella vita, senza dire quando.
Durante l'ascolto 2, prova a notare dove chi canta usa ciascuno.

examples.en: Will you still call me when you move to London?
examples.it: Mi chiamerai ancora quando ti trasferirai a Londra?

examples.en: I will cook when I get home.

options: Text me when you get home.
Text me when you getting home.
Text me when you are get home.
Text me when you will get home.
steps.why: After when, even for the future, we use the present simple: when you get home.
steps.why_it: Dopo when, anche per il futuro, si usa il present simple: when you get home.

steps.q: I will help you when I ___ (finish) work.
steps.q_it: Ti aiuterò quando finirò il lavoro.
steps.why: After when we use the present simple, not will.
steps.why_it: Dopo when si usa il present simple, non will.

steps.q: I ___ (see) many beautiful cities in my life.
steps.q_it: Ho visto molte belle città nella mia vita.
steps.why: Life experience, no exact time: present perfect (have seen).
steps.why_it: Esperienza di vita, senza tempo preciso: present perfect (have seen).

steps.q: Make a question about the future.
answers: Will you still like me when I move abroad
steps.why: Will + subject + still + verb, then the when-clause.
steps.why_it: Will + soggetto + still + verbo, poi la frase con when.

steps.title: Now listen (listening 1 and 2)
en: Open your music app and listen once. Try to catch at least four words from the table. Then listen again and notice the three grammar points.
Come back when you finish and answer the questions about meaning.
it: Apri la tua app di musica e ascolta una volta. Prova a riconoscere almeno quattro parole della tabella. Poi riascolta e nota i tre punti di grammatica.
Torna qui quando hai finito e rispondi alle domande sul significato.

steps.q: The singer asks the same kind of question again and again. What is she really testing?
steps.q_it: Chi canta fa più volte lo stesso tipo di domanda. Cosa sta davvero mettendo alla prova?
options: Whether the other person can sing
Whether the other person has enough money
Whether love depends on looks and youth
Whether the other person remembers her birthday
steps.why: The question is about love that stays when beauty and youth are gone.
steps.why_it: La domanda riguarda un amore che resta quando bellezza e giovinezza sono finite.

steps.q: The song remembers wild summer nights and bright city lights. Why does it do that?
steps.q_it: La canzone ricorda notti d'estate sfrenate e luci della città. Perché lo fa?
options: To complain that the city was too noisy
To advertise a holiday
To contrast a bright, exciting past with an uncertain future
To explain why she wants to move to another city
steps.why: The glamorous memories make the fear of losing them stronger.
steps.why_it: I ricordi glamour rendono più forte la paura di perderli.

steps.q: Her question is not only a question. What does she probably want?
steps.q_it: La sua domanda non è solo una domanda. Cosa vuole probabilmente?
options: To win an argument
To end the relationship
To get directions
Reassurance, not just information
steps.why: She already hopes for a yes. She wants to feel safe.
steps.why_it: Spera già in un sì. Vuole sentirsi al sicuro.

steps.q: In one part she imagines heaven and the person she loves. What does this suggest?
steps.q_it: In una parte immagina il paradiso e la persona che ama. Cosa suggerisce?
options: She is planning a holiday
She hopes their love will continue even after life
She is afraid of flying
She wants to forget him
steps.why: Heaven here is about love that goes beyond this life.
steps.why_it: Il paradiso qui riguarda un amore che va oltre questa vita.

steps.q: Why can this song fit a film about wealth, parties and lost love?
steps.q_it: Perché questa canzone può adattarsi a un film su ricchezza, feste e amore perduto?
options: It explains a historical event
It is fast and good for dancing
It is about cooking and food
It mixes glamour with a fear of loss
steps.why: Glamour and loss are the two sides of the song, and of the film's world.
steps.why_it: Glamour e perdita sono i due lati della canzone, e del mondo del film.

steps.q: Which sentence is the best summary of the message?
steps.q_it: Quale frase è il miglior riassunto del messaggio?
options: She is sure the other person will leave.
Everyone should live in the city.
Beauty is always more important than love.
Love should not depend on youth and beauty, but she is not sure it does not.
steps.why: The doubt is the heart of the song.
steps.why_it: Il dubbio è il cuore della canzone.

steps.q: I will always be your friend ___ you are old. (quando)
steps.q_it: Sarò sempre tuo amico quando sarai vecchio.

steps.title: Your task this week
en: Listening 3: listen with your eyes closed and think about the singer's question.

In your notes write four sentences in your own words: (1) Do you think love can depend on looks? Why or why not? (2) Use will in one sentence. (3) Use when + present simple in one sentence. (4) Use the present perfect for something you have done in your life.
Do not copy the words of the song.
it: Ascolto 3: ascolta a occhi chiusi e pensa alla domanda di chi canta.

Nelle note scrivi quattro frasi con parole tue: (1) Pensi che l'amore possa dipendere dall'aspetto? Perché sì o no? (2) Usa will in una frase. (3) Usa when + present simple in una frase. (4) Usa il present perfect per qualcosa che hai fatto nella vita.
Non copiare le parole della canzone.

cards.ex: My legs are aching after the run.
I will remember this day forever.
We had a wild night in Rome.
Her ring has a small diamond.
I ate nothing but bread today.
